app.transcriber.title: Transcriber
app.transcriber.header_description: Record or import audio and transcribe it locally in this browser. Nothing is sent to a transcription API or a model provider.
transcriber.mic_denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone access, or import an audio file instead.
transcriber.decode_failed: Could not decode that audio. Try a different file, or re-record.
transcriber.too_long: That clip is longer than the 10 minute maximum for on-device transcription. Trim it and try again.
transcriber.status_no_speech: No speech detected in this clip.
transcriber.first_use_notice: The first transcription downloads speech and speaker models to this browser (a few hundred MB); later clips reuse them. Everything runs on this device — no audio leaves your browser.
transcriber.speaker_notice: Speakers are labeled automatically as up to three anonymous voices, with overlaps marked; they are not identified by name and every label needs human review.
transcriber.save_pending: Submitted for approval; not yet saved.
transcriber.save_no_upload: File uploads are unavailable; cannot save the recording.
transcriber.no_audio: Record or import audio before saving with the recording.
transcriber.empty_transcript: There is no transcript to save yet.
